dict.string: Apple Bridge needs access to your calendars to list, create, update, and delete calendar events on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs full access to your calendars to list, search, read, create, update, and delete calendar events on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs to add events to your calendars on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs access to your reminders to list, create, update, complete, and delete reminders on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs full access to your reminders to list, read, create, update, complete, and delete reminders on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs access to your contacts to search and retrieve contact information on behalf of your AI assistant.
Apple Bridge needs to send Apple Events to control Mail and Maps applications on behalf of your AI assistant.
